# `oaap connect`

the outer side of a tunnel: keys inner nodes dial in with (oaap.net.connector 0.1, RFC-0033).

**Root:** needs `sudo`.

## Usage

```sh
oaap connect [--tenant TENANT] [-n LINES]
                    {key,list,offers,log,exposures,exposure} [name] [second]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `action` | what to do -- see Actions below |
| `name` | key: issue\|revoke\|list; offers/log: the tunnel label; exposure: close\|log |
| `second` | key issue/revoke: the tunnel label; exposure close: the name |
| `--tenant TENANT` | key issue: the tenant the tunnel serves (default: the default tenant) |
| `-n, --lines LINES` | log: how many calls (default `30`) |

## Actions

Whether an action needs `sudo` is read from the rule the node enforces, with the other arguments left out (e.g. `node care` reads, `node care measure` needs `sudo`).

| Action | Needs `sudo` |
|---|---|
| `key` | yes |
| `list` | yes |
| `offers` | yes |
| `log` | yes |
| `exposures` | yes |
| `exposure` | yes |
